message.text: I should search for other implementations of the markdown.Service interface to see if there are mocks in tests or alternative implementations elsewhere in the codebase.

This confirms there's exactly one concrete implementation (`*service`, unexported, backed by goldmark), constructed once via `markdown.NewService`, and shared across three holders.

h13.

**Implementation:** the unexported `*service` type in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60` (implements the `markdown.Service` interface declared at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`), which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance configured with the memos-specific tag/mention extensions.

**Construction:** `markdown.NewService(opts ...Option)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85` — is the sole constructor for this interface in the codebase (only one call site outside tests). It is invoked once, in `NewAPIV1Service`, with both extensions enabled:

```48:51:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
```

That single `markdownService` instance is then assigned into `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` and threaded into the other holders at server wiring time (`server/server.go:85`).

**Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface:**
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the constructing owner; used e.g. in `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`, `memo_service.go:108,447`).
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, populated via `NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)` at `server/server.go:85` (reuses the same instance).
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, populated via its `NewRunner(store, markdownService)` constructor (though, per the earlier `h08` finding, this runner's `RunOnce`/constructor is not actually wired up anywhere in production code, so this holder is currently unused at runtime).

(A separate test-only instance is also constructed in `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` for test fixtures, but that doesn't run in production.)
